title: Tight Quantum Indifferentiability Bounds for Multi-Round Sponge
summary: Existing quantum-indifferentiability bounds for the multi-round sponge construction are non-tight; determining tight bounds remains open.

formal_statement.body: Quantum indifferentiability has been established for the multi-round sponge construction, but the resulting bounds are not tight. Determine tight quantum-indifferentiability bounds for the multi-round sponge construction.

scope.domain: Quantum indifferentiability analysis of the multi-round sponge construction.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine tight quantum-indifferentiability bounds for the multi-round sponge construction.

citations.label: Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers

progress.summary: The source reports concurrent work establishing quantum indifferentiability for the multi-round sponge construction while explicitly noting that its bounds remain non-tight.
